
A '''word''' can be a '''lojban-word''' or a [[Morphology: special characters on-lojban-word]].

A '''lojban-word''' can be a [[Morphology: cmene|cmene]], a [[Morphology: c|cmavo]] or a [[Morphology: brivl|brivla]].

If the string begins with a [[Morphology: cmene|cmene]], extract it, else if it begins with a [[Morphology: c|cmavo]], extract it, else if it begins with a [[Morphology: brivl|brivla]], extract it, else it begins with a [[Morphology: special characters on-lojban-word]], and so extract it.
